protocol.name: M1_STOP_ATTRIBUTION_AND_ONE_COST_BREAKEVEN_V1
protocol.baseline: 123 entered unique symbol/side/signal/stop/target records from m1-trend-context-2026-11-15.json;71SL49TP3open; source31symbols run42879077420

diagnostic.false_break: M1 close back at/inside broken boundary in first5 completed held minutes before SL candle. Diagnostic only.
diagnostic.profit_before_stop: Net hypothetical exit at completed M1 closes strictly before stop candle, fees/spread/slippage same baseline. Thresholds positive,0.25R,0.5R,1R.
diagnostic.continued_after_stop: Original target touched in a strictly later M1 candle, before original signal+4h; not assume wider stop would be safe.

single_candidate.activation: At a completed held M1 close, net liquidation value after modeled fees and execution costs >=0.5 of original unit stop risk.
single_candidate.action: Move stop to smallest tick-rounded price covering modeled round-trip costs, effective only from next minute. Never widen stop; original TP unchanged.
single_candidate.ambiguity: Active stop takes precedence over target within same minute, including BE-target ambiguity. Adverse gaps exit at worse open, even if protection loses money.
single_candidate.entry: Unchanged actual baseline entry mid, time and position quantity; no new filter, no reentry, no risk increase.
single_candidate.horizon: Original common4h from confirmation; open positions remain censored and additionally mark-to-market at4h for fair comparison.

protocol.evaluation: Whole sample plus both existing calendar weeks; exploratory reused history, not out-of-sample. Report TP,originalSL,protected exits,open separately; netpositive count never relabeled as TP win rate.
protocol.screening_criteria: Promising only if total marked R and profit factor improve overall and markedR does not deteriorate in either week; otherwise do not promote. Independent new-period validation still required before deployment.
protocol.scope: Read-only audit branch, no production/Telegram/orders changes. No threshold search after result.
limitations: Synthetic fills/book,zero funding, frozencontracts, current gate retrospective.
Independently normalizedR across overlapping signals is not portfolioROI.
M1 no actual intraminute sequence; conservative stop-first.

protocol.name: M1_EARLY_FAILED_BREAK_EXIT_V1
protocol.baseline: Same123M1 entries,25Oct-7Nov2026, same entry/size/SL/TP/costs; no other filter or BE protection.

prior_rejected_test.name: 0.5R cost-covering stop
prior_rejected_test.result: Rejected: closedR16.283->10.781, total markedR17.668->10.781; worsened both weeks.

protocol.single_change: If any of the first5 held M1 candles closes at/inside original broken box boundary, schedule full exit at next minute open. Before scheduling, honor originalSL/TP touched in current candle. On scheduled exit open, originalSL/TP gaps take precedence; otherwise execute open with unchanged cost model. Never use next minute high/low to choose exit.
protocol.success_screen: MarkedR and profit factor higher overall, markedR no worse in either existing week; otherwise reject. Same reused historical sample; passing is exploratory only and requires independent new-period validation.
protocol.scope: One separately frozen sequential hypothesis after rejecting BE, no combined conditions, no thresholdsweep, no live changes.
protocol.reporting: TP,SL,failed-break exits andopen separately; positive-net percentage not relabeled TP hit rate. Original4h horizon andopen mark forfair comparison.

decision: Reject both modifications; no improvement under predeclared same-history screen; no live changes.
